text_simplified: One of the pillars of tarbiyah is for the parent to be a role model for his children: he hastens to the good he commands them and stays away from the evil he forbids them, because contradiction between words and actions causes confusion in children and prevents them from benefiting from his advice. The Shaykh likened this to a doctor who prescribes medicine but does not take it himself, and he cited the words of Shu'ayb (peace be upon him) to his people, that he does not wish to oppose them by doing what he forbids them.
